name: Graph-Based Entity Resolution and Rule-Based Blocking
shortfall_explanation: HyperBlocker is a real GPU blocking artifact, but no license was detected for redistribution of a new snapshot. Similarity search alone is not the full entity-resolution blocking contract.
limitation_notes: A matching input variant can qualify without supporting every optional mode. Missing canonical adapters and absent runtime validation remain separate from research collection eligibility.
